source: Ken French data library (daily, weekday calendar; 12 industries VW; 6 ME×Prior(12-2) VW BIG HiPRIOR)

sleeves.I1/I2/I4: FF12 industries VW, top k by 252-row total return at row d-1, equal weight, monthly, drift between
sleeves.BH: French 6 ME×Prior(12-2) daily VW 'BIG HiPRIOR', minus 1.0%/yr drag

scaling.vol: annualized std of the sleeve's own unscaled daily returns, rows d-126..d-1; if fewer than 126 rows of sleeve history: exposure 1.0

rule.filter: F: market level < 200-row SMA at row d-1 → exposure × 0.5
rule.turnover: sum |Δ risky weights| (RF leg not counted)
